text:
marie: Quick async checkpoint — hotpath performance sprint. Kernel batch, continuous batching, KV cache improvements. Short TL;DR: three things blocking rollout: 1) kernel PR review backlog, 2) perf regression with seq=1024 on dev canary, 3) KV eviction spike causing tail latency.

ajay: I'm taking kernel PR #4291 for review, will land fixes for the batching edge by EOD. pinging @kevin for microkernel test vector.

kevin: repro'd the seq=1024 slowdown locally. Looks like attention fallback at step ~512. I added a quick perf trace: `perf record -g -- ./bench --seq 1024 --batch 6` — stack shows fallback to generic_gemm in stage 2.

sara: KV metrics — saw eviction rate jump to 120/s at 11:02 which correlates with canary traffic spike. Increasing reserve won't solve root cause. I'm adding a soft limit to prefetcher to reduce churn.

marie: Ownership check: ajay=kernel fixes, kevin=profiling + repro, sara=kv prefetch tuning, ops=canary infra. If anyone can't take their item, flag here.

ops: Deploy canary (canary-3) rolled back at 11:05 due to OOM on node-arn-07. Logs: `OOM killed process runtime` (we've attached the node log). We're standing by to repro with a larger instance.

kevin: @ops can you rerun the workload with `--batch 4 --seq 1024 --threads 8` on a g5.2xlarge? I want to confirm mem scaling before kernel patch.

ops: Yep, scheduling a run now. ETA ~20m. I'll post the run id when started.

ajay: small note on PR: added unit test to cover partial-KV cache hit path. Patch link: https://git/repo/pull/4291 (assigning to @marie for quick review before merge)

marie: I'll skip the full review and LGTM the critical hotfix; follow-up cleanup can be another PR. Please also add a short release note for Dedicated customers.

sara: rolled out prefetch soft-limit (config: `prefetch.max_inflight=12`) to canary cluster. Monitoring now — eviction rate down 80% in the first 5m.

kevin: initial g5 run shows reduced mem growth but still a 15% perf delta vs baseline. I'll attach flame graphs to the ticket.

marie: Plan for next 24h: ajay lands kernel hotfix, kevin posts flame graphs + root cause, sara keeps watch on kv, ops re-runs canary after kernel patch. If all green we promote canary-3. If not, fallback to engine-v1. Questions?

ajay: No blockers from me. I'll ping when PR is merged. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll post artifacts in the ticket. Expecting one follow-up micro-optimization.

sara: noted, alerting on any eviction >30/s. Will escalate if that threshold hits.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused automatically due to rollback. Manual resume permitted by ops/admins.

marie: thanks team. Keeping this async — please update thread with short pings only. :eyes:
